capabilities: Look up dictionary entries on hover while reading
Search dictionaries with full-text, fuzzy and prefix matching
Import MDict and TEI Lex-0 dictionaries by drag and drop
Transliterate text between Latin schemes and native scripts
Export the current entry as a Markdown note
extras: Transliteration is described as experimental and only approximate; dictionary CSS is isolated in its own wrapper so dictionaries cannot restyle notes; commands reject input over 100,000 characters.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to read reference dictionaries inside the vault or to convert classical scripts to and from Latin transliteration.
summary: Dictionary reader and transliteration tool for Obsidian that opens MDict and TEI Lex-0 dictionaries and converts text between 18 script schemes.
